definitions.explanation: A vast, dense forest that looks like a sea when viewed from above. Most famously associated with Aokigahara at the base of Mt. Fuji.

examples.english: It's dark inside the sea of trees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ふもと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な{樹海|じゅかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A vast sea of trees stretches out at the foot of Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上空|じょうくう}→上空：03080_joukuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{山々|やまやま}→山々：04809_yamayama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|おお}う→覆う：02020_oou⟧{樹海|じゅかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Viewed from above, the sea of trees covering the mountains looked just like a green ocean.

notes:
A poetic compound of {樹|じゅ} (tree) and {海|かい} (sea), describing a forest so vast and dense that it resembles an ocean when seen from a high vantage point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {樹海|じゅかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}い{込|こ}む→迷い込む：17603_mayoikomu⟧: to wander into the forest
- {樹海|じゅかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: a sea of trees stretches out
- {青木ヶ原樹海|あおきがはらじゅかい}: Aokigahara forest
- {樹海|じゅかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧: deep within the forest

CULTURAL NOTE:
The word is strongly associated with {青木ヶ原樹海|あおきがはらじゅかい} (Aokigahara), the dense forest at the base of ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧. This forest, formed on hardened lava, is known for its thick canopy and easy-to-get-lost terrain. It has unfortunately also become associated with suicide, a topic handled sensitively in Japanese media.
